blocks.text: SDLC software banane ka munazzam tareeqa hai jo yaqeeni banata hai ke software maiyar ke usool poore kare aur theek kaam kare. Software developers aur engineers ise software ke design, development aur testing ki rehnumai ke liye istemal karte hain. SDLC kai marahil par mushtamil hai (Fig. 1.1), aur har marhale ke alag kaam aur maqasid hain: requirement gathering, analysis, design, coding ya implementation, testing, deployment aur maintenance.

blocks.alt: Chhe hare dabbe baen se daen seerhiyon ki tarah neeche utarte hain: Requirement, Analysis, Design, Coding/Implementation, Testing aur Maintenance, har ek par chhota nishan. Har dabbe se hara teer agle dabbe mein jata hai. Maintenance se ek lakeer neeche neeche wapas chalti hai aur har pichhle dabbe ke baen pehlu mein dakhil hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: System development life cycle ke marahil (kitab ki Figure 1.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Seedhe teer batate hain ke kaam ek marhale (stage) se agle marhale mein jata hai: Requirement, phir Analysis, Design, Coding, Testing aur aakhir mein Maintenance. Neeche wali lambi lakeer Maintenance se shuru hoti hai aur har pehle marhale mein wapas jati hai. Matlab software chalne ke baad koi nayi zaroorat ya ghalti saamne aaye to kisi bhi pichhle marhale par wapas ja kar tabdeeli (change) ki ja sakti hai.

items: Requirement gathering: samajhna aur jama karna ke software ko kya karna hai.
Design: mansooba banana ke software kaisa dikhega aur kaise kaam karega.
Testing: bugs dhoondna aur theek karna.
Deployment: software users ke liye dastiyab karna.
Maintenance: ise chalta aur naya rakhna.

blocks.prompt: Software developers SDLC kyun istemal karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh munazzam tareeqa hai jo design, development aur testing ki qadam ba qadam rehnumai karta hai, ta ke software maiyar poora kare aur theek kaam kare; har marhale ke wazeh kaam aur maqasid hain.

items: SDLC: munazzam tareeqa jo design, development aur testing ki rehnumai karta hai ta ke software maiyar poora kare.
Marahil: requirement gathering, (analysis), design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance (Fig. 1.1).
